description: Returns a screenshot with every interactive element outlined and numbered, plus a table mapping each number to its best selector and a stability score. This is the tool to use before acting on a page: look at the image, pick a number, then use that number's selector. Far more reliable than guessing a selector from the DOM.

include.description: "controls" covers buttons, inputs and selects; "all" adds links and landmarks.

viewport.description: Render the page at a breakpoint before capturing. "current" uses the window as it is.

name: annotate_interactive
title: Numbered map of interactive elements
